**About The Company**
Deloitte helps organizations navigate complex business challenges through technology, innovation, and human-centered solutions. Our Human Capital team transforms technology platforms and develops capabilities that support our clients’ success. We bring together expertise across product, data, artificial intelligence, security, and engineering to build solutions that are practical, responsible, and designed to scale. Within this environment, the HC Forward team is advancing AI products and analytics that help people and organizations make better-informed decisions.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI and Data Science Engineer II, you will build and operate the trusted data, feature, and retrieval foundations that power Human Capital AI and analytics products. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role for an engineer who can turn data and AI requirements into dependable production capabilities. You will develop reproducible datasets and features, establish quality and lineage practices, and enable secure data consumption for predictive machine learning and large language model applications.
  
  
You will work closely with an AI Data Engineer responsible for ingestion, curation, governance, and platform foundations, as well as a Lead AI Solutions Architect responsible for end-to-end architecture, integration patterns, and non-functional requirements. You will also collaborate with product, data science and machine learning, security, and platform engineering partners. Together, you will deliver pipelines and services that support model training, real-time inference, and generative AI experiences using Claude-, GPT/Codex-, Gemini-class, and other models. Your work will account for governance, observability, reliability, and cost and performance considerations throughout the development lifecycle.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, software engineering, information systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Professional experience building and operating data pipelines, data products, or machine learning and AI systems in production environments.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience writing maintainable, testable, and well-documented code.
* Experience with cloud-based data and AI services, distributed processing, workflow orchestration, and modern data storage patterns.
* Understanding of data modeling, data quality, metadata, lineage, access controls, and governance practices.
* Familiarity with machine learning workflows, feature engineering, model training, and real-time or batch inference.
* Knowledge of LLM application patterns, including retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, and evaluation, is an advantage.
* Ability to collaborate across technical and business teams, communicate trade-offs, and contribute effectively in an iterative delivery environment.
* Commitment to responsible AI, information security, privacy, and the careful handling of sensitive data.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain reliable data pipelines and services for AI, machine learning, and generative AI use cases.
* Create governed, reproducible datasets and features that support model development, evaluation, and production use.
* Build and improve retrieval and data access layers that enable secure, relevant context for LLM-powered experiences.
* Implement validation, monitoring, lineage, and observability practices to make data and services trustworthy and supportable.
* Partner with architecture, data, product, security, and platform teams to translate requirements into scalable implementation plans.
* Apply engineering standards for version control, automated testing, deployment, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Investigate data and service issues, improve reliability, and tune solutions for appropriate performance and cost.
* Contribute to responsible AI practices, including appropriate controls for data access, model use, and ongoing solution evaluation.

Deloitte offers opportunities to work on consequential technology challenges alongside professionals across disciplines. Team members can develop their skills through varied project experience, collaboration, and learning opportunities. Benefits and programs are designed to support employee well-being and may vary based on role, location, and eligibility.

**About The Company**
Capital One is a technology-driven financial services company focused on solving meaningful customer and business challenges through innovation. Teams across the organization bring together engineering, data science, product, and operations expertise to build reliable digital experiences and responsible, scalable technology. At Capital One, makers and problem-solvers work collaboratively, share ideas, and use modern tools to address complex needs. The company’s work in artificial intelligence and machine learning supports a broad range of products and business capabilities, with an emphasis on delivering value while managing risk and protecting customer trust.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Machine Learning Engineer 4, you will help advance AI capabilities by designing, developing, and operating machine learning solutions in production. You will partner with Product, Data Science, Data Engineering, and other engineering teams to turn business problems into dependable systems and useful model outcomes. This role combines machine learning, software engineering, data infrastructure, and operational ownership. You will contribute to technical decisions across the model lifecycle, from data and feature selection through training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining. You will also help ensure solutions are scalable, secure, explainable, and aligned with responsible AI and software development practices. The posted Chicago salary range is $179,400 to $204,700 annually; compensation for other locations is based on the applicable location range. The role may also qualify for performance-based incentives.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative discipline, such as Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, or Engineering.
* At least four years of programming experience with Python, Java, Golang, or C++.
* At least four years of machine learning experience with industry-standard frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow and libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn.
* At least four years of experience using and operating distributed systems, including Spark or Ray, to prepare AI and machine learning data.
* At least two years of experience deploying and operating production machine learning solutions and cloud services on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including Kubernetes-managed containerized systems.
* Preferred: a master’s or doctoral degree in a related technical field, and experience optimizing models, algorithms, configurations, and infrastructure.
* Preferred: experience with software development practices, including source control, testing, code review, and CI/CD, as well as resilient deployment, monitoring, alarms, and incident preparation.
* Preferred: practical knowledge of machine learning methods, model architectures, training approaches, evaluation, and diagnosing issues such as underfitting and overfitting.
* Preferred: experience scaling data pipelines, leading technical development of machine learning solutions, or authoring research on a machine learning technique, model, or proof of concept.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, test, and deliver machine learning models and software components that address real-world business needs in partnership with Product and Data Science.
* Apply knowledge of modeling methods to inform infrastructure and modeling choices, including data and feature selection, training, hyperparameter tuning, dimensionality, bias and variance, and validation.
* Develop and test application code, validate models, automate testing, and contribute to software that supports advanced big data and machine learning applications.
* Build or leverage cloud architectures and optimized data pipelines that support model training, evaluation, and production use at scale.
* Deploy, monitor, maintain, and retrain production models; use CI/CD practices and operational safeguards to support reliable releases.
* Work within a cross-functional Agile team, communicate technical decisions, and contribute to continuous improvement across the machine learning lifecycle.
* Manage code responsibly, reduce vulnerabilities, support model governance, and apply responsible and explainable AI practices.
